literal_meaning: ঘরের মানুষ বা ঘরের লোকজন (household people)
example_sentences_in_bangla: খয়রাতের কাজ ঘরের লোক দিয়ে শুরু করা উচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: Family members are the most trustworthy companions.
Charity should begin with one's own relatives.
history: This idiom is part of the proverb suggesting that charity or good deeds begin with one's own family members.
note: Often used in contexts emphasizing familial obligations and starting benevolence from home.
